shape: §4.2 flat question list: options are plain strings, label = A + index
subject: english

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I ___ my grandparents during the holidays.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: during the holidays 指刚过去的假期，用一般过去时，visit 的过去式是 visited。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What did you do last Sunday?  — I ___ to the park.
questions.explanation: 问句用了 did，回答也要用过去式，go 的过去式是 went。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — Where ___ you go last summer?  — I ___ to Hainan.
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句用 did 提问、动词回原形；回答要用过去式，所以第二空是 went。“did; go”错在回答没有用过去式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Last Sunday I ___ a film and ___ a book.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: see 和 buy 都是不规则动词：see—saw—seen，buy—bought—bought。两个空都要用过去式，seen 是过去分词，不能单独作谓语。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句是一般过去时（  ）
options: I will visit my uncle tomorrow.
I visit my uncle every week.
I am visiting my uncle now.
questions.explanation: yesterday 是过去的时间，动词用过去式 visited。every week 配一般现在时，now 配现在进行时，tomorrow 配将来时。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面句子中，动词过去式写错的一项是（  ）
questions.explanation: go 是不规则动词，过去式是 went，不能加 -ed。“goed”是孩子最常写错的形状之一。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Last summer I went to Beijing with my parents. We visited the Great Wall.” 这句话说的是（  ）
options: 去年夏天“我”和父母去了北京，参观了长城
questions.explanation: last summer 是去年夏天，went 和 visited 都是过去式——整句都在讲已经发生的事，不是计划。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读对话：“— Did you go swimming yesterday? — No, I didn't. I stayed at home and read a book.” 从回答看，“我”昨天（  ）
options: 待在家里看书，没有去游泳
questions.explanation: No, I didn't 是否定回答，后面 stayed（待在家里）和 read（读书）才是实际做的事。回答里的动词全是过去式。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Tom usually gets up at six, but yesterday he got up at eight.” 这句话告诉我们（  ）
options: 汤姆昨天六点就起来了
汤姆平时六点起床，昨天八点才起
汤姆每天都是八点起床
questions.explanation: usually 配一般现在时 gets，yesterday 配过去式 got——两个时间对两种时态，这是英语里最要紧的一条线。
tags: 一般过去时与假期活动

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “去游泳”的英文是（  ）
questions.explanation: go + doing 表示去做某项活动：go swimming、go fishing、go shopping。动词要用 -ing 形式，不加 to。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What did you do during the holidays?  — I ___ my grandparents in the countryside.
questions.explanation: 问句用 did 提问，回答要用过去式 visited。during the holidays 指的是刚过去的那个假期。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Last week we ___ a picnic and ___ many photos.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: have—had—had，take—took—taken。两个空都是谓语，要用过去式；taken 是过去分词，不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My hometown is a small village near the river. There are many trees and a big lake.” 这段话说的是（  ）
options: “我”的家乡是河边的小村庄，有很多树和一个大湖
questions.explanation: village 是村庄，near the river 在河边，lake 是湖。按词找信息，不要凭“家乡”两个字想当然。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“I went to Shanghai with my family. We visited the Bund and ate delicious food. We had a great time.” 这段话主要讲（  ）
options: “我”和家人去上海，玩得很开心
questions.explanation: 三句分别是地点、活动、感受，合起来就是“去了上海、玩得开心”。主要意思看整体，不能只盯一个词。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“I went back to my hometown. It is a small town, but it is much more beautiful than before.” 从这句可以知道（  ）
options: 家乡是个小镇，现在比以前漂亮多了
说话人假期没有出过门
questions.explanation: went back 是“回去了”，but 之后才是重点：small town，而且 more beautiful than before——转折词后面常是说话人真正想说的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组全是“假期活动”的短语（  ）
options: go swimming / visit grandparents / take photos
get up / brush teeth / go to bed
questions.explanation: 第二组是每天起床睡觉的作息，第三组是星期，第四组是颜色——只有第一组是假期里做的事。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What did you do during the holidays?  下面回答最恰当的一项是（  ）
options: I visited my grandparents and read some books.
questions.explanation: 问“做了什么”，就要答做过的事，动词用过去式。答“我是学生”答非所问；Yes, I did 只能回答一般疑问句。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 对话中有一处不当：“— Where did you go last week? — I go to Beijing. — Did you have a good time? — Yes, I did.” 不当之处是（  ）
options: 第二句的 go 应改成 went
第一句的 did 应改成 do
第三句的 Did 应改成 Do
第四句的 did 应改成 do
questions.explanation: 问和答都要用过去时：问句用了 did go，答句就该用 went。一处时态没跟上，整段对话就错。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 要向同学介绍自己的假期，下面开头最合适的一项是（  ）
options: During the holidays, I went to my hometown with my parents.
I am a student in Grade Six.
questions.explanation: 介绍假期，第一句就该说清“什么时候、和谁、去了哪里”。只报姓名、只说“假期很好”，都还没进正题。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 说“我假期过得很开心”，下面表达最完整、最自然的一项是（  ）
options: I am happy during the holidays.
I had a great time during the holidays. I visited my grandparents and we went fishing together.
questions.explanation: 英语里“过得开心”说 have a good/great time，时态用过去式；只说 happy 缺动词，句子立不起来。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 要把假期的三件事说成一段连贯的话，下面顺序最合理的一项是（  ）
options: 只说感受，别的一句不说
先说去了哪里，再说做了什么，最后说感受
先说感受，再说去了哪里，再说做了什么
questions.explanation: 英语叙事也讲顺序：地点、活动、感受。先讲感受，听话的人还不知道你在说哪一段经历。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: He ___ to school by bike every day.
questions.explanation: 主语 He 是第三人称单数，every day 表示习惯，动词加 -es：goes。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My sister ___ her homework after dinner.
questions.explanation: My sister 是第三人称单数，do 要变成 does。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My father ___ TV in the evening, but my parents ___ TV in the morning.
questions.explanation: my father 是单数用 watches，my parents 是复数用 watch。同一句话里两个主语形式不同。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My brother ___ English every evening, and he ___ English films on Sundays.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 两个空的主语都是 he。study 是“辅音字母 + y”结尾，变三单要把 y 改成 i 再加 -es：studies；watch 以 ch 结尾，加 -es：watches。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的动词形式是正确的（  ）
options: She go to school by bus.
questions.explanation: He 是第三人称单数，like 加 -s 变成 likes。She go 应改成 goes，They likes 应改成 like（复数不加 -s），I goes 应改成 go。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的动词形式用错了（  ）
options: My mother cook dinner every day.
Lily washes her face at seven.
Tom and Jim play football after school.
questions.explanation: My mother 是第三人称单数，cook 要加 -s 变成 cooks。其余三句：Lily 用 washes，Tom and Jim 是两个人用 play，The cat 用 runs，都对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Beibei gets up at six thirty every morning. She has breakfast at seven.” 从句子看，Beibei 几点起床（  ）
questions.explanation: gets up at six thirty 就是六点半起床。七点是她吃早饭的时间，不要把两个时间看反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Mr Li gets up at five. He runs for half an hour, and then he has breakfast.” 从句子看，李先生吃早饭之前先（  ）
questions.explanation: runs for half an hour 在 has breakfast 之前，and then 说明顺序：先跑步，再吃早饭。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Tom doesn't like ball games. His father runs every morning. Last month Tom began to run with him.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 汤姆现在也早上跑步了
汤姆的爸爸不喜欢运动
questions.explanation: began to run with him 是“开始跟着爸爸跑”，所以现在他也早上跑步。他不喜欢球类运动，更不会每天打球。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I ___ eat ice cream. I don't like it at all.（选择恰当的频度副词）
questions.explanation: don't like it at all 是“一点也不喜欢”，所以从来不吃：never。其余三个都表示吃，跟后半句矛盾。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My grandpa ___ for a walk after supper.（用 often 填空，选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: often 这类频度副词放在实义动词前面：often goes。主语 my grandpa 是第三人称单数，go 要变成 goes。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 把四个频度副词按“总是—经常—有时—从不”的顺序排列（  ）
questions.explanation: 频度从高到低是 always（总是）、often（经常）、sometimes（有时）、never（从不）。sometimes 的频率低于 often，别放反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中频度副词的位置正确（  ）
options: I am always happy at school.
I always am happy at school.
Always I am happy at school.
I am happy always at school.
questions.explanation: 句子里有 be 动词时，频度副词放在 be 后面：I am always happy。放在 am 前面、句首或句末都不合英语习惯。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的意思与其他三句不同（  ）
questions.explanation: sometimes 是“有时”，放在句首、动词前或句末，意思都一样。never 是“从不”，意思正好相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My sister often helps my mother cook, but today she is busy with her homework.” 下面理解正确的是（  ）
options: 她不是每天都帮妈妈做饭
questions.explanation: often 是“经常”，不是“每天”；today 她有事，今天就没帮。把 often 当成 every day，是读这类句子最常见的错。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I enjoy ___ mooncakes with my family.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面接动名词，不接 to do：enjoy eating。eat、to eat、eats 都不能直接用在这里。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My sister likes ___ and she enjoys ___.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: like 和 enjoy 后面都可以接动名词：likes singing、enjoys dancing。两个空要一致，不能一个用 -ing、一个用原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Lily enjoys ___ storybooks, and she likes ___ pictures of the people in them.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: enjoy 和 like 后面都接动名词，两个空都要用 -ing：reading、drawing。前后两个动词用法一致，不要只改一个。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 enjoy 的用法正确（  ）
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面只能接动名词：enjoy reading。接 to do、动词原形或三单形式都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句有错误（  ）
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面不能接 to do，应改成 They enjoy playing games。其余三句的 -ing 形式都用对了。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My cousin enjoys ___ noodles. He often ___ noodles for us.” 两个空依次应填（  ）
questions.explanation: 第一个空在 enjoys 后面，用动名词 cooking；第二个空是谓语，主语 He 是第三人称单数，用 cooks。同一个 cook，两种形式各管一处。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We usually ___ mooncakes at the Mid-Autumn Festival. Last year we ___ them at home.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: usually 表示习惯，用一般现在时 eat；last year 是过去的时间，用过去式 ate。eat 的过去式是不规则的 ate。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My family ___ a big dinner every Spring Festival, but last Spring Festival we ___ it at my grandma's home.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: every Spring Festival 说习俗，用一般现在时；my family 在这里指一家人，看作复数用 have。last Spring Festival 说去年，用过去式 had。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Beibei ___ her grandparents every festival. Last year she ___ there by train, but this year she ___ a plane.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: every festival 是习惯，用 visits；last year 用过去式 went；this year 说的是今年已经发生的事，也用过去式 took。三个时间词定三种形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的时态用对了（  ）
options: Last year we eating mooncakes at home.
Last year we ate mooncakes at home.
Last year we eat mooncakes at home.
Last year we eats mooncakes at home.
questions.explanation: last year 是过去的时间，动词要用过去式 ate。eat 是原形，eats 是三单，eating 不能单独作谓语。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的时间词与动词形式不搭配（  ）
options: Last week we visited my uncle.
Every year we watch the moon.
Last night we watched the moon.
questions.explanation: yesterday 是过去的时间，watch 要改成 watched。其余三句：every year 配 watch，last night 配 watched，last week 配 visited，都对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中两个动词的时态都用对了（  ）
options: Every year we ate mooncakes and watched the moon.
Every Mid-Autumn Festival we eat mooncakes, and last year we ate them in the garden.
Every year we ate mooncakes, and last year we eat them.
Last year we eat mooncakes and watch the moon.
questions.explanation: 前一句说习俗用 eat，后一句说去年用 ate；一句话里两种时间各配各的时态才对。其余三句都把两种时间配错了。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“The Mid-Autumn Festival is in autumn. On that day families get together and eat mooncakes.” 中秋节这天，一家人会（  ）
questions.explanation: get together and eat mooncakes 就是“聚在一起吃月饼”，这是中秋节的习俗。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“We went to my grandma's home. We ate mooncakes in the garden and looked at the moon.” 去年他们是在哪里吃月饼（  ）
questions.explanation: 去了奶奶家，吃月饼的地点是 in the garden，也就是院子里。公园是另一篇短文里的地点，不要混。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Last year we went to the park. This year my grandma is ill, so we will stay at home again.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
questions.explanation: will stay at home again 说明今年又在家过，不去公园。去年是去了公园的，所以“每年都去”不成立；奶奶是今年生病。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It ___ sunny and cool tomorrow.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: tomorrow 是将来时间，用 will + 动词原形；说天气要用 be 动词，所以是 will be。will 后面不能直接跟形容词，is 和 was 说的是现在和过去。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: There ___ a football match in our school next Friday.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: “将有”用 There will be，不能写 There will have——have 前面已经有 there 了。next Friday 说明是将来。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It ___ rainy tomorrow, so we ___ the sports meeting next Saturday.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 两个空都是将来的事：天气用 will be，举办运动会用 will hold（hold 是实义动词，前面用 will）。时间词 tomorrow 和 next Saturday 都定住了将来。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句写的是将来的事（  ）
options: We will visit the farm next week.
We visited the farm last week.
We visit the farm every week.
We are visiting the farm now.
questions.explanation: next week 是将来时间，动词用 will visit。last week 配过去式，every week 配一般现在时，now 配现在进行时。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 will 后面用错了（  ）
options: He will goes to Beijing tomorrow.
She will come back next Monday.
questions.explanation: will 后面一律用动词原形，will goes 应改成 will go。will 不随主语变，也没有第三人称单数的形式。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的时间词与 will 不搭配（  ）
options: I will go to the zoo yesterday.
I will go to the zoo tomorrow.
I will go to the zoo next Sunday.
I will go to the zoo this evening.
questions.explanation: yesterday 是过去的时间，不能和 will 连用，应改成 went。tomorrow、next Sunday、this evening 都是将来时间。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“It will be sunny and cool tomorrow. We will go to the park.” 明天的天气怎么样（  ）
questions.explanation: sunny and cool 就是“晴天，凉爽”。两个词要一起看，只看到 sunny 会漏掉 cool。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“There will be a party in our classroom on Friday. We will sing and dance.” 星期五教室里会有什么（  ）
questions.explanation: There will be a party 就是“会有一场聚会”，后面 sing and dance 说的正是聚会上的活动。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“It will be rainy tomorrow, so we won't have the picnic. We will stay at home and watch a film.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 野餐改不成了，他们在家看电影
questions.explanation: won't have the picnic 是“不野餐了”，原因是下雨；后面说在家看电影，说明计划改了。so 前后是原因和结果。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It is ___ today. Take your umbrella with you.（选择恰当的天气词）
questions.explanation: 要带伞说明在下雨，用 rainy。sunny 和 windy 都不需要伞，cloudy 只是多云。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It is very ___ today. Let's fly a kite in the park.（选择恰当的天气词）
questions.explanation: 放风筝要有风，所以是 windy。rainy 和 snowy 都不适合出门放风筝。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: It is ___ today, so we can't go out. We ___ at home.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: It is 后面要用形容词 rainy，不能用名词 rain 或动词 rains；will 后面要用动词原形 stay，不能加 -ing。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的天气词用对了（  ）
questions.explanation: It is 后面接形容词：sunny、rainy、windy。sun、rain、wind 是名词，不能直接放在 It is 后面。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中天气与活动配得不合理（  ）
options: It is windy today. Let's fly a kite.
It is snowy today. Let's go swimming in the river.
It is rainy today. Let's stay at home and read.
It is sunny today. Let's go to the park.
questions.explanation: 下雪天到河里游泳既不安全也不合常理。其余三句：下雨在家看书、晴天去公园、有风放风筝，都对得上。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组句子里的天气词全部用对了（  ）
options: It is sun. / It is rain. / It is wind.
It is sunny. / It is rain. / It is windy.
It is sun. / It is rainy. / It is wind.
It is sunny. / It is rainy. / It is windy.
questions.explanation: 三句都要用形容词形式：sunny、rainy、windy。只要有一处写成名词 sun、rain、wind，整组就不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I'd like a ___ of bread for breakfast.（选择正确的量词）
questions.explanation: 面包论“片、块”，用 a piece of bread。bottle 和 glass 用于水、牛奶这类液体，pair 用于成双的东西。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: There are two ___ of milk on the table.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: two 后面的量词要变复数：glass → glasses（以 s 结尾加 -es）。glasss 是拼错，a glass 是单数。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I will bring two ___ of orange juice and three ___ of bread.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 两个空前面都是大于 1 的数，量词都要变复数：two bottles、three pieces。不可数名词本身不变，变的是量词。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个量词与后面的词搭配正确（  ）
questions.explanation: 纸论“张、片”，用 a piece of paper。bottle、glass 用于液体，pair 用于成双的东西，都不能配 paper。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中量词写错了（  ）
options: I'd like a glass of milk.
I'd like a cup of tea.
I'd like two bottle of water.
I'd like two bottles of water.
questions.explanation: two 后面的 bottle 要变复数：two bottles of water。其余三句的量词都是单数，配 a 或没有数词，用原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组里的量词都用了复数形式（  ）
options: three bottle of juice / two cups of tea
three bottles of juice / two cups of tea
three bottle of juice / two cup of tea
three bottles of juice / two cup of tea
questions.explanation: 两组都有大于 1 的数词，量词都要加 -s：three bottles、two cups。只要有一组漏了复数，整组就不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I ___ swim, but I can't skate.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: can 是情态动词，后面接动词原形，也没有第三人称单数形式：I can swim。can to 和 cans 都不对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What can I do for you? — You can ___ me carry the box.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: can 后面用动词原形 help。What can I do for you? 是主动提出帮忙的说法，回答也用 can + 原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Lingling ___ cook noodles, but she ___ make cakes.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: but 表示转折，前后要一正一反：会做面条，不会做蛋糕。can 没有第三人称单数形式，cans 是错的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 can 用得正确（  ）
options: She can to play the piano.
questions.explanation: can 后面用动词原形 play，can 本身不加 -s，也不接 to。所以只有 She can play the piano 是对的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 can 后面用错了（  ）
options: We can go there by bus.
questions.explanation: can 后面要跟动词原形，can sings 应改成 can sing。can 不随主语变，主语是 he 也不加 -s。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 can 的意思与其他三句不同（  ）
questions.explanation: Can you help me? 是“请求别人帮忙”，can 表示请求；其余三句的 can 都表示“会、有能力做”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We ___ waste water. Water is useful.
questions.explanation: 水很有用，所以不应该浪费，用 shouldn't + 动词原形 waste。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We should ___ the tap after we wash our hands.
questions.explanation: should 后面接动词原形，不加 -s、-ing 或 -ed。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You look tired. You ___ go to bed early.
questions.explanation: 对方看起来累，是给建议，用 should；shouldn't 意思相反，can't 表能力，aren't 后不接动词原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We ___ use both sides of the paper, and we ___ throw the bottles away.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 两个空一条建议一条禁止：纸要两面用（should），瓶子不能乱扔（shouldn't）。and 连接的是并列的两条建议，方向相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句是在给别人提建议（  ）
options: They will go to the park.
questions.explanation: should 用来提建议：你应该多喝水。can 说能力，is 说身份，will 说将来，都不是建议。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 should 后面用错了（  ）
options: We should use a bag when we shop.
We should to plant more trees.
questions.explanation: should 后面直接跟动词原形，不接 to：should plant。should 和 can 一样，后面一律用原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“We shouldn't waste water. We should turn off the tap after washing our hands.” 从句子看，洗完手应该（  ）
questions.explanation: turn off the tap 就是关水龙头，这是句子给的具体建议。shouldn't waste water 是总的原则。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Use both sides of the paper. Don't throw old books away. Give them to younger children.” 这段话主要说的是（  ）
options: 怎样节约用纸、让旧书再用
questions.explanation: 三句说的是一件事的三个做法：纸用两面、旧书别扔、送给更小的孩子。合起来就是节约用纸、让书再用一次。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“It is not easy to save water. We should start with small things. Turning off the tap is a good start.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 只有大人才需要节约用水
节约用水可以从关水龙头这样的小事做起
节约用水很容易，不用做什么
questions.explanation: start with small things 和 a good start 都说从小事做起；前半句 not easy 说的是不容易，不是做不到。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: big 的比较级是（  ）
questions.explanation: big 是重读闭音节、末尾只有一个辅音字母，要双写 g 再加 -er：bigger。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: This bird is ___ than the first one.
questions.explanation: 有 than 表示两者比较，用比较级 bigger。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: This book is ___ than that one.
questions.explanation: interesting 是多音节词，比较级在前面加 more，不加 -er，也不能用最高级 most。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: hot 和 easy 的比较级分别是（  ）
questions.explanation: hot 是重读闭音节、末尾只有一个辅音字母，双写 t 再加 -er：hotter；easy 以“辅音字母 + y”结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 -er：easier。两种规则不一样。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪个比较级写对了（  ）
questions.explanation: tall 直接加 -er：taller。tallor 拼错，talller 多了一个 l（只有重读闭音节才双写），more tall 是多余——单音节词不加 more。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中形容词的 -er 形式写错了（  ）
options: This bag is heavyer than that one.
This bag is heavier than that one.
My hair is longer than yours.
This box is bigger than that one.
questions.explanation: heavy 以“辅音字母 + y”结尾，要变 y 为 i 再加 -er：heavier。heavy 不能直接加 -er。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My brother is ___ than me.（用 tall 的正确形式填空）
questions.explanation: 有 than 表示两个人比高矮，用比较级 taller。tall 是原级，tallest 是最高级（三者以上才用）。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The Yangtze River is ___ than the Yellow River.（用 long 的正确形式填空）
questions.explanation: 两条河相比，用比较级 longer。more longer 是重复——long 已经加了 -er，前面不能再加 more。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: This box is ___ and ___ than that one.（用 heavy, big 的正确形式填空）
questions.explanation: 一个 than 同时带两个比较级：heavy 变 y 为 i 加 -er，big 双写 g 加 -er。两处规则不同，不能只改对一个。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句的比较级句型是完整的（  ）
options: Tom is more tall than Jim.
questions.explanation: 比较级句型是「甲 is + 比较级 + than + 乙」，三样都不能少：taller、than、Jim。少 than 或漏 is 都不成句。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中比较级用错了（  ）
options: This apple is bigger than that one.
My hair is more long than yours.
My hair is longer than yours.
questions.explanation: long 是单音节词，比较级加 -er：longer，不加 more。more 只用于 interesting、beautiful 这类多音节词。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中两个比较级都用对了（  ）
options: This box is bigger and heavyer than that one.
This box is more big and heavier than that one.
This box is biggest and heavier than that one.
This box is bigger and heavier than that one.
questions.explanation: big 双写 g 加 -er，heavy 变 y 为 i 加 -er，两个都要对。其余三句各有一处错：heavyer、more big、biggest（最高级）。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“The blue bird is bigger than the yellow one. It is also more beautiful.” 蓝色的鸟比黄色的鸟（  ）
questions.explanation: bigger 是更大，more beautiful 是更好看，also 说明两个优点都有。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Tom is 12 and Jim is 10. Tom is taller, but Jim runs faster.” 从句子看（  ）
options: 汤姆更高，吉姆跑得更快
questions.explanation: but 表示转折：身高上汤姆占优，跑步上吉姆占优。taller 和 faster 分属两个人，不要都算到一个人头上。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“My old bike is small. The new one is bigger, but it is heavier, so I ride it more slowly.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 新车更大更重，骑起来更慢
questions.explanation: bigger、heavier 说的是新车，so 引出结果：骑得更慢（more slowly）。三个比较级连成一条因果链。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: — What's wrong with you?  — I ___ a headache.
questions.explanation: 问病情用 What's wrong with you，回答是一般现在时；主语 I 用 have，不用 has。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句表示「我感冒了」，说法正确？
questions.explanation: have a cold 是固定搭配：cold 前要加 a，且 cold 在这里不可数，不能加 -s；be 动词不能和 cold 搭配表示生病。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: My sister ___ a bad cold, so she ___ at home today.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 主语 my sister 是第三人称单数，have 要变成 has；后半句主语 she 也是第三人称单数，stay 加 -s。两个空都要变。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tom ___ a headache and a fever. He ___ to see a doctor and ___ some medicine.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 第一空主语 Tom 用 has；第二空 needs to 后面接原形；第三空与 see 并列，同属 needs to 后面，也用原形 take。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“I have a cold. My head hurts and I can't stop coughing.” 这个孩子怎么了（  ）
questions.explanation: have a cold 是感冒，head hurts 是头疼，coughing 是咳嗽。三个症状对得上“感冒”。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Lily has a fever. The doctor says she should stay in bed for two days and drink more water.” 医生让 Lily（  ）
questions.explanation: stay in bed for two days 是卧床两天，drink more water 是多喝水。should 后面的两件事都是医生说的。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Tom has a cough but no fever. He can go to school, but he shouldn't run.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 汤姆能上学，但不能在操场上跑
questions.explanation: doesn't have a fever 否掉了发烧；can go to school 和 but he shouldn't run 是两条相反的态度：能去，但不能跑。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句表示“我发烧了”（  ）
questions.explanation: have a fever 是固定搭配：fever 前要加 a，也不能加 -s。be 动词不能和 fever 搭配表示生病。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 have / has 用错了（  ）
questions.explanation: my parents 是两个人，看作复数，要用 have。其余三句的主语分别是单数 my father、I、she，用 has 或 have 都对。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 看病时，见到医生最先说的一句是（  ）
questions.explanation: 看病先说自己的感受：I don't feel well（我不舒服）。Goodbye 是告别，Thank you 是道谢，Here you are 是递东西。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 把看病的三句话排成通顺的顺序：① I have a cold. ② What's wrong with you? ③ You should drink more water.（  ）
questions.explanation: 先问（②），再答（①），最后给建议（③）。问—答—建议，这是一段看病的对话顺序。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组问答搭配得最合适（  ）
options: — What's wrong with you? — It's Monday.
— What's wrong with you? — I like apples.
— What's wrong with you? — I have a bad cold.
— What's wrong with you? — I'm twelve.
questions.explanation: What's wrong with you? 问的是身体怎么了，只能答病情：I have a bad cold。年龄、星期、喜好都答非所问。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You have a cold. You ___ drink more water.
questions.explanation: 感冒了多喝水是建议，用 should + 动词原形；shouldn't 意思相反，can't 表能力，aren't 后不能直接接动词原形。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You shouldn't ___ too much ice cream when you have a fever.
questions.explanation: shouldn't 是情态动词的否定形式，后面一律接动词原形，不加 -s、-ing 或 -ed。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: You have a fever. You ___ stay in bed and ___ more water.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 发烧了应该卧床、多喝水：should 后面两个动词都用原形 drink，且 should 只管一个方向，不能用 shouldn't。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Tom has a bad cold. He ___ go to school today, and he ___ take the medicine three times a day.（选择正确形式）
questions.explanation: 重感冒不该去学校（shouldn't），但要按时吃药（should）。同一段建议里两条方向相反，靠 and 并列。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“You have a cough. You should drink more water and shouldn't eat ice cream.” 咳嗽的时候应该（  ）
questions.explanation: should 后面是应该做的：多喝水；shouldn't 后面是不能做的：吃冰激凌。两个方向要分清。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“Lily should take the medicine and stay in bed, but she shouldn't read for long.” 医生给 Lily 的建议是（  ）
options: 只吃药，可以长时间看书
吃药、卧床，但不要长时间看书
questions.explanation: should 后面两件事（吃药、卧床），but 后面是 should not：不要长时间看书。三件事要一起看。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 读句子：“You should drink more water. If you still feel bad after three days, you should see a doctor.” 从句子可以知道（  ）
options: 感冒三天还没好，就应该去看医生
一感冒就一定要马上去医院
感冒三天一定会自己好
questions.explanation: if ... after three days 说的是“三天后仍不舒服”才去看医生，不是一感冒就去；前面还说要多喝水。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句是给病人的建议（  ）
questions.explanation: You should ... 是给别人提建议；其余三句只是陈述病情或身份，没有建议的意思。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一句中 should / shouldn't 用得不合适（  ）
options: You have a fever. You should go swimming.
You have a cold. You should drink more water.
You have a cough. You shouldn't eat ice cream.
You have a headache. You should have a rest.
questions.explanation: 发烧了还去游泳，与养病相反，应该用 shouldn't。其余三句的建议都合常理：多喝水、不吃冰激凌、休息。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 同学感冒了，你对他说（  ）
options: You should eat more ice cream.
You should run in the playground.
questions.explanation: 感冒了多喝水是合适的建议。吃冰激凌、不去看医生、去操场跑，三条都跟养病相反。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “— I have a bad cold. — ______” 横线上最合适的一句是（  ）
options: You should take the medicine and have a rest.
I have a cold, too, thank you.
questions.explanation: 对方说重感冒，接一句建议最合适：吃药、休息。回答年龄、身份、时间都答非所问。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 下面哪一组建议适合发烧的病人（  ）
options: eat more sweets / go swimming / stay up late
have a rest / drink more water / take the medicine
run in the playground / eat ice cream / watch TV all night
go to school / play football / drink cold water
questions.explanation: 发烧要休息、多喝水、吃药，三件事都指向养病。其余三组都是消耗体力或受凉的做法，与病情相反。
